beats.say: Barbara Palvin was discovered walking in Budapest at just age 13.
She made her major runway debut for Prada in February 2010.
By 2012, she became an official ambassador for L'Oreal Paris.
She then made her acting debut in the 2014 film Hercules as Queen Antimache.
She was later ranked fourth in the Maxim Hot 100 in 2016.
She married actor Dylan Sprouse on 15 July 2023 in Albertirsa, Hungary.

facts: Barbara Palvin was born on October 8, 1993, in Budapest, Hungary.
She was discovered on the streets of Budapest at age 13 while walking with her mother.
Her runway debut was for Prada during Milan Fashion Week in February 2010.
In 2012, she became an ambassador for L'Oreal Paris.
She made her acting debut in the 2014 film Hercules as mythological queen Antimache.
In 2016, she was ranked 4th in Maxim Hot 100.
She married American actor Dylan Sprouse on July 15, 2023, in Albertirsa, Hungary.
